clips.title: The story
paras: At sacred stones in Mulgore and Durotar, Minor Manifestation of Earth waits unseen. Fledgling shamans who drink Earth Sapta can meet the spirit and receive rough quartz for carving their first earth totem.

Earth spirits dwell beneath dirt and stone, but reaching them takes a deliberate rite. At Kodo Rock in Mulgore and Spirit Rock in Durotar, Minor Manifestations of Earth linger beyond ordinary sight, surrounded by lesser elemental presences. Only initiates who drink Earth Sapta, a draught brewed by shamanic mentors, can cross the veil between the physical world and the elements. When an initiate makes contact, the spirit grants the earth's blessings and a piece of rough quartz. The novice can use it as the spiritual focus for making an Earth Totem.
